shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -R .agents/skills/gravity-ui && echo ---- && cat AGENTS.md && echo ---- && ls && cat package.json

find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo ---- && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done && echo ---- && cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo ---- && rg -n -i "dropdown|menu|popup|action" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -30 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button ThemeProvider Icon && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head -3

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button Icon 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; node -e "console.log(require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version, require('@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version)"; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/DropdownMenu/; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E "^(Ellipsis|Pencil|TrashBin|Copy|ChevronDown|ArrowDown)"

find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path "*DropdownMenu*" -name "*.d.ts" | head -20; echo ----; D=$(dirname $(find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path "*DropdownMenu/types.d.ts" | head -1)); cat "$D/types.d.ts"; echo ----; cat "$D/DropdownMenu.d.ts"; echo ----; grep -n "@gravity-ui/icons" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'

(curl -sS -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7.txt && echo "fetched $(wc -c < /tmp/uikit7.txt) bytes" && rg -n -i "^#+ .*dropdown ?menu" /tmp/uikit7.txt | head) ; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n -A3 '"\./styles/\*"\|"\./styles' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -8
timeout 90 npm install @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "exit=$?"; grep -n '"@gravity-ui' package.json
